global.interaction_honesty: Across this project's 3,860 genes only 52 have a partner whose zebrafish experiments channel reaches 0.4. Experimental, transferred and predicted edges must be drawn differently or the network is a lie.
global.fin_tissue_proteomics: No PaxDb zebrafish dataset is fin tissue, so no abundance number in this pack is a fin measurement.
global.flying_fish: UniProt has no flying-fish proteome (25 entries in Exocoetidae, mostly barcoding fragments); AlphaFold DB has no model for any protein of any gliding mammal in this project's panel. A structural comparison across gliders cannot be done today.
global.aves: Class Aves is this project's frozen holdout. No bird sequence, structure, interaction or annotation is in this pack; rows whose species matched /Aves|bird/i were dropped at build time.
